messages.text: I'd like to make these web of this sections can open in the iphone on the same wi-fi route. let's investigate and improve this

Good idea. I've passed it to the lead, who decides on a tool fix.
- Today the Try-it links on the Proposals page point to this Mac only (localhost), so the iPhone can't open them.
- We already track a close problem (I-126: the page shows the Wi-Fi link as plain text, not as a link). The fix can cover both: every Try-it link gets a version that opens on the iPhone over the same Wi-Fi.
- The pages are already served on the Wi-Fi network for the phone tests, so the fix mainly needs the right link.
What you need to do: nothing now. I'll reply here when it's fixed.

**Yes, I've started this.** A tool agent (ts-i126) is now working on it.
- Every Try-it option on the Proposals page will get a second link that opens on your iPhone over the same Wi-Fi.
- If that option's page isn't being served on the Wi-Fi yet, the page will say so instead of showing a dead link.
- The console itself stays on this Mac only. Only the test pages are shared on Wi-Fi.

**What you need to do:** nothing. I'll reply here when it's live. Until then, the phone links in T-076 still work.

Done: the Proposals page now shows iPhone links for each Try-it page.
- Under each Try it panel there is a new box, "On the iPhone (same Wi-Fi as this Mac)". It has a link for page A and for page B, each with a Copy button.
- Tap the link in Safari on the iPhone. The phone must be on the same Wi-Fi as the Mac.
- These pages only show up once the Mac shares them. An agent or the lead does that with one command, which the box shows when a page is not shared yet. Ask in this thread and they'll run it. The links appear within 30 seconds.
- Only the test pages go on the Wi-Fi. The console itself stays on this Mac.
- Wi-Fi links in proposal questions and answers now open as real links, not plain text.
- A possible next step: a "Share on Wi-Fi" button on the page, so you don't have to ask. That needs the lead's OK first.
What you need to do: nothing. Next time you want a proposal on the phone, ask in its thread.
Try-it panel of PR-017, i cannot access on my iphone yet. let's investigate

Fixed: the PR-017 pages are now shared on the Wi-Fi.
- On the Proposals page, PR-017's Try it has the box 'On the iPhone': page A (http://lan:5558/) and page B (http://lan:5560/). Both answer, checked at 08:24 UTC.
- But please put the iPhone down for now. A timed phone check (P-094, the avatar row) is running on it. At 08:22 UTC the phone dropped off the Mac mid-check, possibly because it was being used. Did you open Safari or unlock the phone around then?
- I'll write here as soon as the phone is free for you.
What you need to do: answer the Safari question. Then wait for my 'phone free' message before you try the links.

Go ahead: try the countdown proposal (PR-017) on the iPhone now. Your turn comes before the agents' phone tests.
- On the iPhone, open Page A at http://lan:5558/ and Page B at http://lan:5560/. Both are on the Wi-Fi now. The phone must be on the same Wi-Fi as the Mac.
- No cable needed for this.
- Note: the clock not counting (T-085) is still open, so don't decide PR-017 yet. This is just to look.
- When you are done, plug the iPhone back into the Mac, unlock it, and press Done on step C-043 in Your steps. The heat check then picks up again.
What you need to do: try the two links, then plug the phone back in and press Done on C-043.

Correction: the iPhone is back, and you were right, you hadn't unplugged it.
- I wrongly guessed you took it off the cable. The Mac really did lose the phone's cable connection at 08:20 UTC, by itself. Cause unknown for now (cable, USB port or the Mac's phone service).
- Unplugging and replugging fixed it. The phone is visible again at 08:24 UTC.
- If it happens again, we will log it in incident I-127 and look for a pattern.
What you need to do: nothing. Trying PR-017 on the phone over Wi-Fi is still fine.

history.note: User wants Proposals-page Try-it links (A/B pages, e.g. PR-017) to open on the iPhone over Wi-Fi, not localhost only. Overlaps I-126 (lan placeholder shown as text). Needs a toolsmith: a phone link per Try-it (<link> the twin when https). Holding reply sent.
